## What's Changed
* Implement mcp tools by @vedubhat in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2513
* chore(deps): update jackson monorepo to v2.22.0 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2532
* Fix change-status flipping siblings on a path-parameter change by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2523
* Ensure additional query parameters are preserved for mock by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2545
* Multi trigger orchestrator by @Sushant092003 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2538
* Annotate BCC source locations as a chain through external $refs by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2543
* chore(deps): update dependency io.netty:netty-codec-http to v4.2.15.final by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2511
* Annotate BCC breadcrumbs with source locations across external $refs by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2533
* BCC: emit structured breakages metadata for the grouped HTML report by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2544
* Remove SPECMATIC_BCC_REPORT feature flag by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2551
* Fix flaky test in SpecmaticMcpServerTest by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2558
* Normalize filesystem spec paths for federated CTRF reports by @jaydeepk in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2550
* Fix: More graceful handling of query parameter collisions between top-level query params and query param object properties by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2562
* Support for nested query param objects and arrays by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2563


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/compare/2.46.4...2.46.5
